text.question: According to API 510, who is responsible for the overall maintenance, inspection, and repair of pressure vessels?
text.explanation: API 510, Section 4.2.1 states the owner-user has the responsibility for the inspection, maintenance, and repair of the pressure vessel.

text.question: A pressure vessel has a remaining corrosion allowance of 0.125 inches and a corrosion rate of 0.010 inches per year. What is the maximum allowed interval for the next internal inspection?
text.explanation: Remaining Life = Allowance / Rate = 0.125 / 0.010 = 12.5 years. API 510 Section 6.4.1.1 states the interval shall not exceed 10 years or half the remaining life, whichever is less. Half-life is 6.25 years.

text.question: Under API 510, which of the following is considered an 'Alteration'?

options.option: Replacing a nozzle with one of the same size and rating
The addition of a new reinforced nozzle larger than existing ones
Replacing a shell course with a material of the same specification
Grinding out a crack and weld repairing it

text.explanation: API 510 Definition 3.1.2 defines alteration as a physical change which has design implications. Adding a new nozzle is an alteration.

text.question: According to API RP 571, which damage mechanism is characterized by a network of fine cracks on the surface of 300 series stainless steel exposed to chlorides and water?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.17 describes Chloride SCC as occurring in austenitic stainless steels under tensile stress in the presence of chlorides and water at elevated temperatures.

text.question: In ASME Section VIII, Div. 1, what is the required joint efficiency (E) for a seamless head with no weld attachments?
text.explanation: Per ASME Section VIII, Div. 1, Table UW-12, a seamless head is generally assigned E=1.00 if it meets the requirements of UW-12(d).

text.question: Which NDE method is specifically used for detecting surface-breaking discontinuities in ferromagnetic materials?
text.explanation: ASME Section V, Article 7 covers Magnetic Particle Testing, which is specifically for surface and near-surface flaws in ferromagnetic materials.

text.question: According to API 510, a pressure test is generally required after which of the following?

options.option: Replacing a gasket on a manway

text.explanation: API 510 Section 5.8.1 states a pressure test is normally required after an alteration or a major repair.

text.question: Per ASME Section IX, what is the 'P-number' for carbon steel (e.g., SA-516 Grade 70)?
text.explanation: ASME Section IX, Table QW-422 classifies standard carbon steels as P-No 1.

text.question: API RP 576 states that the most common cause of a pressure relief valve failing to open at the set pressure is:

options.option: Corrosion products sticking the disc to the seat

text.explanation: API RP 576 Section 5.1 identifies corrosion and fouling (sticking) as primary causes of PRV malfunction.

text.question: When performing a thickness measurement (UT) on a vessel at 200°F, what adjustment is usually required?

options.option: The temperature must be lowered to 70°F first
The velocity of sound in the material changes, requiring a correction factor
The transducer must be replaced every 10 minutes

text.explanation: ASME Section V, SE-797 (Article 23) and API 510 note that elevated temperatures affect the speed of sound, requiring a correction (approx. 1% per 100°F).

text.question: Which damage mechanism is associated with the loss of material due to a chemical reaction with sulfur compounds at temperatures above 450°F?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.61 identifies Sulfidation as corrosion from sulfur compounds at high temperatures, often affecting carbon and low-alloy steels.

text.question: According to API 510, how many thickness measurements are required on a vessel with 5 years of remaining life during an external inspection?

options.option: None, unless specified by the inspector
Every CML identified in the plan

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.3.3 states that thickness measurements are not required during an external inspection unless there is reason to believe the vessel wall is thinning.

text.question: What is the minimum holding time for a hydrostatic test per ASME Section VIII, Div 1?

options.option: There is no specific minimum time; only until the inspection is complete

text.explanation: ASME Section VIII, Div 1, UG-99 states the test pressure shall be held for a sufficient time to allow for examination of all joints and connections.

text.question: In ASME Section IX, which of the following is a 'Non-essential Variable' for the SMAW process?

options.option: A change in the groove design

text.explanation: Groove design is typically a non-essential variable for WPS (QW-402), meaning it can be changed without requalifying the PQR.

text.question: API RP 578 requires what percentage of alloy materials to be verified in a Material Verification Program for a new high-criticality system?
text.explanation: API RP 578 Section 4.3 notes that for high-criticality services, 100% verification is often recommended.

text.question: What is the static head pressure at the bottom of a vessel containing 40 feet of liquid with a specific gravity of 0.85?
text.explanation: Static Head = 0.433 psi/ft * Height * SG = 0.433 * 40 * 0.85 = 14.722 psi.

text.question: Per API 510, if a vessel is buried and cannot be internally inspected, what alternative is allowed?

options.option: Calculating remaining life based on soil samples only

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.4.1.2 allows for non-invasive or on-stream inspection techniques when physical access is restricted.

text.question: Which document provides guidelines for 'Temper Bead' welding as an alternative to PWHT?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.7.4.3 provides specific procedures for Temper Bead welding when PWHT is not practical.

text.question: In RT (Radiography), what is the IQI used to measure?
text.explanation: ASME Section V, Article 2 uses Image Quality Indicators (IQI) to determine the sensitivity and quality of the radiograph.

text.question: According to RP 571, 'CUI' (Corrosion Under Insulation) is most prevalent at what temperature range for carbon steel?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.22 identifies the range for CUI in carbon steel typically as 10°F to 350°F.

text.question: What is the maximum allowed interval for an external inspection on a pressure vessel?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.3.2.1 states the external inspection shall not exceed five years.

text.question: A welder qualifies by welding a pipe in the 6G position. This qualifies the welder for which positions?
text.explanation: ASME Section IX, Table QW-461.9 states the 6G position qualifies for all welding positions.

text.question: ASME Section VIII Div 1: What does the term 't' represent in the nozzle reinforcement formula?
text.explanation: In UG-37, 't' usually refers to the required thickness of the shell calculated by the internal pressure formulas.

text.question: According to API 510, who must authorize any repair or alteration work before it begins?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.1 requires API inspector authorization before starting repair/alteration.

text.question: Which API document provides detailed procedures for calculating the remaining strength of a corroded shell?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.4 refers to Fitness-For-Service (API 579) but also contains basic guidelines for remaining strength in Section 5.7.

text.question: In Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), what is the disadvantage of using 'Prods'?

options.option: Potential for arcing and localized surface damage

text.explanation: ASME Section V, Article 7 warns that prods can cause arcing at the contact points, which may damage the surface.

text.question: According to API 510, when can 'On-Stream' inspection be performed instead of internal inspection?

options.option: When the vessel is too small to enter
When the corrosion rate is low and the remaining life is over 10 years
Only if authorized by the Jurisdiction

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.4.2.1 specifies conditions where on-stream inspection is acceptable (e.g., low corrosion rate, high remaining life).

text.question: API RP 571: Which damage mechanism results from the formation of iron sulfide scales on steel?
text.explanation: Sulfidation results from sulfur reacting with steel to form iron sulfide scales.

text.question: Per ASME Section VIII, Div 1, what is the 'MAWP'?
text.explanation: ASME Section VIII, Div 1, UG-98 defines MAWP.

text.question: A welder qualifies with an E7018 electrode (F-4). Does this qualify him to weld with an E6010 (F-3) electrode?

options.option: Only if he has 5 years experience

text.explanation: ASME Section IX, Table QW-433: F-4 does not qualify for F-3 (F-3 qualifies only F-3, but F-4 is a different classification group for performance).

text.question: Which API RP 571 mechanism is described as the 'gradual change in microstructure of carbon and low-alloy steels from carbide to graphite'?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.35 defines Graphitization as the decomposition of pearlite into ferrite and graphite nodes.

text.question: According to API 510, if a vessel's service conditions are changed, what must be done?

options.option: Nothing if the MAWP is high enough
A new inspection must be performed immediately
The inspector must authorize the change and determine the new inspection interval
The vessel must be pressure tested to 1.5 times the new pressure

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.2.2 requires rerating or re-evaluating intervals if service conditions change.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 6: What is the minimum time for penetrant dwell when testing for fine cracks?
text.explanation: ASME Section V, Table T-672 generally recommends 10 minutes for many materials, though it varies by standard and temperature.

text.question: Which material verification technique uses an X-ray source to identify alloying elements?
text.explanation: API RP 578 Section 6.2.1 defines XRF as a common method for material verification/PMI.

text.question: API RP 576: When testing a PRV on a test bench, the pressure at which the valve begins to leak or hiss is called:
text.explanation: RP 576 Section 3.37 defines simmer as the audible or visible escape of fluid before the valve pops open.

text.question: In API 510, what is the 'Corrosion Rate' formula?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.1.1 defines the short-term and long-term corrosion rates based on the difference in thickness over time.

text.question: Which damage mechanism involves high-temperature hydrogen reacting with carbon in steel to form methane gas?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.36 defines HTHA as hydrogen diffusion reacting with carbides to form methane bubbles.

text.question: Per ASME PCC-2, what is the minimum thickness for a flush-patch plate repair in a shell?

options.option: Equal to the existing shell thickness

text.explanation: ASME PCC-2 Article 209 generally requires repair plates to be of same thickness and material as the base metal.

text.question: What is the joint efficiency for a Type 1 butt weld that has been fully radiographed per UW-12?
text.explanation: ASME Section VIII Div 1, Table UW-12, Type 1 Full RT = 1.00.

text.question: In ASME Section IX, what does 'F-number' refer to?

options.option: The P-number of the base metal
The grouping of electrodes and filler metals

text.explanation: QW-430: F-numbers are based on the usability characteristics of filler metals.

text.question: API 510: If a pressure vessel is in a non-corrosive service, the internal inspection can be waived if the vessel is:

options.option: Determined by the inspector to have no risk of damage

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.4.2.1.1 provides the criteria for skipping internal inspections for non-corrosive environments.

text.question: RP 571: Which mechanism occurs when stainless steel is exposed to temperatures between 700°F and 1500°F, leading to chromium depletion at grain boundaries?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.58 (related to Intergranular Corrosion) describes sensitization as chromium carbide precipitation at grain boundaries.

text.question: According to API 510, 'Repair' is defined as:

options.option: Replacing a nozzle with a larger one
Work necessary to restore a vessel to a condition suitable for safe operation

text.explanation: API 510 Section 3.1.58 defines repair as work necessary to restore the vessel to its intended safe operating condition.

text.question: What is the required minimum wall thickness for a vessel with P=200 psi, R=30 inches, S=17,500 psi, and E=1.0? (Ignore corrosion allowance)
ASME Section IX: How many tensile tests are required to qualify a WPS?
text.explanation: QW-451.1 requires 2 tensile tests for PQR qualification.

text.question: API RP 576: A rupture disk is often used upstream of a PRV to:

options.option: Reduce the cost of the PRV
Prevent the PRV from leaking or being corroded by the process

text.explanation: RP 576 Section 4.5 notes rupture disks can isolate the PRV from corrosive fluids or prevent leakage.

text.question: Which damage mechanism in RP 571 is primarily a concern during startup/shutdown and at low temperatures?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.8 states brittle fracture occurs in steels at low temperatures when they lose ductility.

text.question: According to ASME Section V, Article 2, the 'Hole-type' IQI should be placed on which side of the weld (normally)?
text.explanation: T-277.1 states the IQI shall be placed on the source side unless inaccessible.

text.question: In API 510, what is the definition of a 'Testing Organization'?

options.option: An entity that provides NDE services but not necessarily repairs
Only the Manufacturer of the vessel

text.explanation: API 510 Definition 3.1.65 describes an entity qualified to perform NDE.

text.question: RP 571: Caustic Stress Corrosion Cracking in carbon steel is most likely at temperatures above:
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.15 states that for carbon steel, caustic SCC is usually a concern above 120°F depending on concentration.

text.question: When checking a PRV 'pop' pressure on a test stand, how many times should it be popped?

options.option: As many times as needed to get two consistent readings

text.explanation: RP 576 Section 6.2.2 suggests multiple pops to ensure consistency and clear the seat.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: What is the hydrostatic test pressure factor for a vessel designed in 2023?
text.explanation: UG-99(b) specifies a hydrostatic test pressure of 1.3 times the MAWP multiplied by the stress ratio.

text.question: Per API 510, an Inspector must have how much experience if they hold a degree in engineering?
text.explanation: API 510 Annex B, Section B.1 states 1 year of experience is required if the candidate has a 4-year engineering degree.

text.question: In ASME Section V, Article 7, what is the 'Yoke' method?

options.option: An electromagnetic device that induces a magnetic field in the part

text.explanation: Article 7 defines the AC or DC yoke as a common tool for Magnetic Particle inspection.

text.question: RP 572: During an internal inspection of a vessel with trays, the inspector should check for:
text.explanation: RP 572 Section 9.3 highlights checking internals like trays for fouling, damage, and levelness.

text.question: What is the maximum thickness of a base metal qualified by a 1/2 inch thick PQR coupon per QW-451.1?
text.explanation: QW-451.1: For test coupon thickness T from 3/16 to 3/4 inch, the max qualified thickness is 2T (2 * 1/2 = 1 inch).

text.question: RP 571: Which damage mechanism is caused by the sudden failure of a material when exposed to tensile stress and a specific corrosive medium?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 2 defines SCC as cracking under the combined action of tensile stress and a corrosive environment.

text.question: According to API 510, what is the required inspection frequency for a pressure-relieving device in typical refinery service?

options.option: As determined by performance history, not to exceed 10 years (typically 5)
Only when the vessel is inspected

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.6.2 and RP 576 suggest intervals based on history, with 5 years being common for clean service, max 10.

text.question: In ASME Section VIII, Div 1, which appendix covers the rules for 'Rounded Indications' in welds found by RT?
text.explanation: Mandatory Appendix 4 provides acceptance criteria for rounded indications.

text.question: Which material is most susceptible to Polythionic Acid Stress Corrosion Cracking (PASCC)?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.46 explains PASCC occurs in sensitized 300 series stainless steels when exposed to sulfide scales, air, and moisture.

text.question: What is the required thickness of a shell if P=150 psi, R=24 inches, S=15,000 psi, E=0.85? (No corrosion)
According to API 510, who must perform the NDE for a repair?

options.option: Personnel qualified in accordance with the owner's requirements or ASME Section V

text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.8 requires NDE to be performed by qualified personnel.

text.question: Which welding process uses a flux-covered electrode?
text.explanation: SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding) uses a consumable flux-covered electrode.

text.question: RP 571: Spheroidization is a change in the microstructure of steel that results in:

options.option: Loss of strength and creep resistance

text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.61 (and 3.55) describes spheroidization as the carbides rounding out, reducing high-temperature strength.

text.question: Per API 510, if a vessel is moved to a new location, what must be done?

options.option: It must be internally and externally inspected to ensure suitability

text.explanation: API 510 Section 6.2.2 requires inspection when a vessel changes location to ensure it is fit for the new service/installation.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 6: After applying the developer, what is the recommended range of time to wait before final interpretation?
text.explanation: T-676.1 states interpretation shall be made within 10 to 60 minutes after developer application.

text.question: API 510: 'Temporary Repairs' must be replaced with permanent repairs at the next:
text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.5.1.1 states temporary repairs should be replaced at the next available maintenance period/internal inspection.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: A vessel nameplate with the letter 'W' signifies:
text.explanation: UG-116(b)(1) uses 'W' for arc or gas welded construction.

text.question: What is the primary concern with 'Ammonia Stress Corrosion Cracking'?

options.option: Copper alloys or carbon steel with anhydrous ammonia

text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.4 identifies SCC in carbon steel when exposed to anhydrous ammonia (especially if air/oxygen is present).

text.question: In API 510, who determines the 'Remaining Life' of a vessel?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.1.1.1 assigns this calculation task to the inspector or engineer.

text.question: Which API document provides inspection practices specifically for pressure vessels?
text.explanation: API RP 572 is titled 'Inspection Practices for Pressure Vessels'.

text.question: What is the carbon steel P-number for SA-106 Grade B pipe?
text.explanation: Per ASME IX Table QW-422, SA-106 Gr B is P-No 1.

text.question: In ASME Section V, Article 7, a calibration of the yoke's lifting power must be done:
text.explanation: T-761 states the lifting power of yokes shall be calibrated annually.

text.question: Per API 510, weld 'Overlays' are typically inspected using which method to check for debonding?
text.explanation: UT is the standard method for detecting lack of bond or laminations in overlays.

text.question: RP 571: 'Erosion-Corrosion' is most commonly found at:

options.option: Elbows, tees, and orifices where flow changes direction

text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.27 notes that erosion-corrosion occurs in areas of high velocity or turbulence.

text.question: According to ASME Section IX, what is a welder qualified for if they weld a plate in the 3G position?
text.explanation: QW-461.9: 3G (Vertical) qualifies for Vertical and Flat.

text.question: API 510: If a vessel is found to be below its required thickness and the corrosion rate cannot be determined, how is the interval set?

options.option: Use data from a vessel in similar service

text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.1.2 allows using data from similar vessels if history is unknown.

text.question: ASME PCC-2: Which article covers 'External Repair of Pressure Equipment Using Magnetic Particle Inspection'?
text.explanation: PCC-2 covers repair methods (like Article 201: Butt-Welded Insert Plates), while NDE methods are in ASME Section V.

text.question: RP 576: A pressure relief valve (PRV) with a 'balanced bellows' is used to:

options.option: Reduce the cost of the valve
Minimize the effect of backpressure on the set pressure

text.explanation: RP 576 Section 4.3 describes balanced bellows as compensating for backpressure.

text.question: API 510: 'Fillet weld patches' can be used as a permanent repair for:

options.option: Only if they are designed by an engineer and meet specific criteria

text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.5.1.2 allows fillet-welded patches if specifically designed/approved under certain constraints.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: What is the minimum temperature for a hydrostatic test?
text.explanation: UG-99(h) recommends the test liquid temperature be at least 10°F above the MDMT (Minimum Design Metal Temperature).

text.question: RP 571: Which damage mechanism involves the loss of material due to high-velocity water droplets impacting a surface?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.27 defines Erosion as mechanical loss of material from the relative movement of fluid and the surface.

text.question: In ASME Section V, Article 1: Who is responsible for establishing a written NDE procedure?

options.option: The NDE Agency / Manufacturer / Repair Organization

text.explanation: Article 1, T-150 states each organization shall have a written procedure for each NDE method.

text.question: API 510: During an internal inspection, the inspector finds pitting. How is the depth of the pitting generally treated for remaining life calculations?

options.option: The deepest pit is subtracted from the thickness, or pitted areas are averaged based on specific rules
Pitting is always fatal to the vessel
Add the pit depth to the wall thickness

text.explanation: API 510 Section 5.7.4 provides rules for evaluating widely scattered pits.

text.question: RP 578: Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES) is unique because it can detect which element that XRF cannot?
text.explanation: RP 578 Section 6.2.2 notes that OES can detect carbon, which is crucial for distinguishing steel grades like 304 vs 304L.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: What is the 'MDMT'?
text.explanation: MDMT is defined in UG-20 as the coldest temperature at which the vessel is designed to operate at pressure.

text.question: What is the primary function of API RP 577?
text.explanation: API RP 577 provides guidance on welding and metallurgy for the refining industry.

text.question: RP 571: 'Sulfide Stress Cracking' (SSC) is a form of:
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.61 (related to H2S mechanisms) defines SSC as a form of hydrogen stress cracking.

text.question: In ASME Section IX, what is a 'PQR'?
text.explanation: QW-103.2: PQR is the record of welding data used to weld a test coupon.

text.question: API 510: What is the minimum required thickness for a shell with P=100 psi, D=48 inches, S=20,000 psi, E=0.85? (No corrosion)
RP 572: Where is 'Napthenic Acid Corrosion' most likely to occur?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.46 and RP 572 highlight this as a high-temperature mechanism in crude units.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 23: When using UT Thickness measurement, what type of calibration is required?

options.option: Comparison with a known thickness block of the same material
Comparison with a piece of wood

text.explanation: SE-797 requires calibration on blocks of known thickness and similar material.

text.question: API 510: If a vessel is in 'intermittent service', how should the corrosion rate be calculated?

options.option: Based only on the time it is under pressure
Based on the total calendar time

text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.1.1 generally uses calendar days to determine the average rate across the life of the asset.

text.question: ASME Section IX: 'Welding Position' is what type of variable for a welder's performance qualification (WPQ)?
text.explanation: QW-350 lists position as an essential variable for the performance qualification of a welder.

text.question: RP 571: 'Carburization' results in:

options.option: Loss of ductility and increased hardness/brittleness

text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.11: Carburization increases the carbon content in the surface, making it hard and brittle.

text.question: API 510: A 'Repair Organization' can be:
text.explanation: API 510 Section 3.1.61 defines several entities that can act as a repair organization.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: What is the standard required thickness of a 2:1 Ellipsoidal head? (t_head formula)
text.explanation: UG-32(d) gives the formula for 2:1 Ellipsoidal heads.

text.question: In API 510, a pressure vessel is defined as a container designed to withstand pressure above:
text.explanation: API 510 Scope excludes vessels below 15 psi.

text.question: RP 571: What is 'Mechanical Fatigue'?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.44 defines fatigue as degradation under cyclic loading.

text.question: API 510: When can an inspector authorize a 'Liner' repair without engineering approval?

options.option: Never; engineering must always be involved in design changes
If it is less than 1 square foot
If the liner is made of carbon steel

text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.1.1 and 8.1.5 require engineering approval for modifications and structural changes.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 6: Penetrant testing 'interpretation' should be done under a minimum lighting of:
text.explanation: T-676.3 requires 100 fc (1000 lux) for color contrast penetrant.

text.question: Which document covers 'Inspection of Pressure-Relieving Devices'?
text.explanation: API RP 576 is the specific standard for PRV inspection.

text.question: Per API 510, 'Major Repair' includes:

options.option: Removing and replacing a large nozzle (NPS 12)

text.explanation: API 510 Definition 3.1.37: Major repairs include replacing large shell sections or nozzles.

text.question: What is the joint efficiency for a Type 2 butt weld (single welded with backing) with Spot Radiography?
text.explanation: ASME Section VIII, Div 1, Table UW-12: Type 2 Spot RT = 0.80.

text.question: RP 571: 'Cl-SCC' in stainless steel is most likely to occur in which fluid?
text.explanation: Chloride SCC is driven by chloride ions in aqueous environments.

text.question: ASME Section IX: A change in the 'A-number' on a WPS is:
text.explanation: QW-404.5: A change in the chemical composition of the weld deposit (A-number) is an essential variable.

text.question: API 510: If a vessel's nameplate is missing, the inspector should:

options.option: Try to establish the vessel's identity and replace the nameplate per code rules
Paint a new one on with a marker

text.explanation: API 510 Section 5.11 provides guidance for nameplate replacement or verification.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 7: When using the 'Prod' method, the spacing should be:
text.explanation: T-752.3 recommends spacing between 3 and 8 inches.

text.question: Which API RP 571 mechanism causes 'blisters' in carbon steel shell plates?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.36 (Hydrogen damage) explains blistering due to atomic hydrogen collecting at inclusions.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: The 'U' stamp signifies:

options.option: The vessel was built to Section VIII, Div 1 rules
The vessel is for underwater use
The vessel is made of uranium

text.explanation: UG-116: The 'U' symbol is the official Code U-stamp.

text.question: What is the maximum allowed time between the start of a MT inspection and the application of the particles?

options.option: They must be applied while the magnetizing current is on (for continuous method)

text.explanation: ASME V, Article 7: The continuous method requires particles to be applied while current is flowing.

text.question: API 510: 'Remaining Life' calculation (L) is equal to:
text.explanation: API 510 Section 7.1.1.1 formula.

text.question: In ASME Section IX, what base metal P-number is '304 Stainless Steel'?
text.explanation: QW-422: Austenitic stainless steels like 304/316 are P-No 8.

text.question: RP 571: 'Temper Embrittlement' affects which materials?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.62: Temper embrittlement is a loss of toughness in Cr-Mo steels after exposure to high temps.

text.question: What is the MAWP of a shell if t=0.5, S=17500, E=1.0, R=24? (Ignore 0.6P term for simplification or use standard formula)
API 510: If a repair is being made to a P-No 4 material, what is the normally required PWHT temperature?
text.explanation: ASME VIII Div 1 Table UCS-56 requires PWHT (approx 1100°F) for P-4 steels.

text.question: RP 576: When a PRV is 'Chattering', it is:
text.explanation: RP 576 Section 3.10 defines chattering as rapid reciprocating motion of the disc.

text.question: According to ASME PCC-2, what is the maximum diameter of a circular fillet-welded patch allowed by most standards?

options.option: Determined by engineering but often restricted to small areas for temporary fixes

text.explanation: PCC-2 Article 212 restricts the use of these patches based on stress and size.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 2: The density of a radiograph for X-ray through the weld should be between:
text.explanation: T-282.1: Density shall be 1.8 to 4.0 for X-ray.

text.question: API 510: 'CML' stands for:
text.explanation: API 510 Section 3.1.13 defines CML.

text.question: RP 571: 'Vibration-induced Fatigue' is most common in:
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.67 notes small bore connections are highly susceptible to vibration fatigue.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: A vessel with an MDMT of -20°F and a thickness of 2 inches usually requires:
text.explanation: UCS-66 curves show that at 2 inches and -20°F, carbon steel is typically below the curve, requiring impact testing.

text.question: API 510: 'Inspector' as used in the code means:
text.explanation: Definition 3.1.8.

text.question: RP 577: 'Undercut' is a weld discontinuity found at:

options.option: The junction of the weld face and the base metal (toe)

text.explanation: Undercut is a groove melted into the base metal at the toe.

text.question: ASME Section IX: For a performance qualification (WPQ) on a pipe, what is the '1G' position?

options.option: Pipe horizontal and rotated during welding

text.explanation: QW-461.4: 1G (rotated) is the flat position for pipe.

text.question: Which document specifies Article 201 for butt-welded insert plates?
text.explanation: ASME PCC-2 Article 201 specifically details the repair of pressure equipment using insert plates.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 6: How should penetrant be removed when using 'solvent-removable' penetrant?

options.option: By spraying solvent directly on the part
By wiping with a lint-free cloth moistened with solvent

text.explanation: T-673.3 prohibits spraying solvent directly on the surface to prevent washing penetrant out of flaws.

text.question: API 510: What is the maximum interval for an internal inspection for a vessel with a remaining life of 4 years?
text.explanation: Half of 4 years is 2 years. Interval = min(10, 0.5*Life).

text.question: RP 571: What is the main driver for 'Sulfidation'?

options.option: Sulfur content in the process and high temperature

text.explanation: Sulfidation occurs in high-temp hydrocarbon streams containing sulfur.

text.question: ASME Section IX: A 'WPS' must be:
text.explanation: QW-103.1: The WPS shall be available for reference and use by the welder.

text.question: In API 510, 'In-Service' inspection includes which of the following?
text.explanation: Section 6.1 lists the various types of inspections.

text.question: ASME Section VIII, Div 1: What is the requirement for a 'Tell-tale' hole in a reinforcing pad?

options.option: It must be left open to the atmosphere (or plugged with grease)
It must be seal welded shut
It must be connected to a pressure gauge
It must be NPS 2 or larger

text.explanation: UG-37(g) requires a tell-tale hole to detect leakage from the inner weld.

text.question: Which damage mechanism involves high temperature (>800°F) and results in the formation of voids and cracks at grain boundaries?
text.explanation: RP 571 Section 3.22 defines Creep as time-dependent deformation at high temperature.

text.question: ASME Section V, Article 7: A 'Pie Gauge' is used for:

options.option: Determining the direction of the magnetic field

text.explanation: T-764.2.1: The magnetic flux indicator (pie gauge) is used to verify field direction.

text.question: API 510: If a pressure vessel is rerated to a higher MAWP, what is mandatory?
text.explanation: API 510 Section 8.2 requires calculations and normally a pressure test to verify the new rating.

text.question: According to RP 576, what is the 'Cold Differential Test Pressure' (CDTP)?

options.option: The set pressure at operating temperature
The set pressure adjusted for backpressure and temperature on the test bench
The pressure at which the valve freezes
The pressure of the cooling water

text.explanation: CDTP is the bench set pressure adjusted for service conditions.
